answer: Diminishing dividend split.** Each agent’s reward share is divided by the count of identities sharing its payout address, and dividends accrue only after a jade lock period during which every sibling identity must post an independent work sample that a random reviewer must accept. Cloning splits nectar across more claimants, so each clone earns a fraction while paying full registration pigment and review labor. The marginal clone is strictly negative-EV: added work and review cost exceeds the diluted share.
